title: Ortlieb Introduces Made-In-House Tidura Waterproof Fabric, Plus a Brand New Bag
content:
Since its founding almost 45 years ago, Ortlieb has manufactured their waterproof bags using locally sourced fabrics in their Heilsbronn, Germany, headquarters. Today, those fabrics got much more local. Ortlieb Introduces their own made-in-house waterproof material, Tidura. And they’re dropping a new bag along with it, because why not.

Ortlieb’s new Tidura material is a TPU-coated woven fabric engineered with their welded-seam construction in mind. On top of designing a material to their exact specifications, Ortlieb can now seamlessly trace it through each production stage should an issue ever arise.

There are two versions of Tidura at launch. Tidura Core mixes protection with everyday usability. It balances weight, durability, and handling. Tidura Strong offers maximum abrasion and tear resistance. It’s designed for heavy loads and demanding daily conditions. These fabrics will feel familiar to anyone who’s touched an Ortlieb bag’s stiff, waxy skin. It’s just like the Ortlieb you know and love.

Ortlieb Tidura Quick Hits:

  • IP67 — Full submersion: Dustproof and protected against submersion up to 1 meter for 30 minutes
  • IP64 — Heavy rain: Dustproof and reliably protected against splash water from all directions
  • IP53 — Spray protection: Protected against internal dust buildup and spraying water up to 60 degrees
  • 100,000 mm water column: Fabric and welded seams tested to 100,000 mm water column
  • Divided into two versions:
    • Tidura Core: Tested to 1,500 Newtons tensile strength and elongation at break
    • Tidura Strong: Tested to 2,400 Newtons tensile strength and elongation at break

For now, Ortlieb is using Tidura Strong in three of their existing products:

  • Back-Roller 20L Zip-Pocket — Rear pannier with QL2.2 mounting system. Black and Lavender.
  • Velocity 23L — Highly regarded, durable commuter backpack with roll closure, padded notebook compartment, and ventilated back panel. Black and Lavender.
  • Duffle Zip — Waterproof travel duffles (40L / 60L) with Tizip lockable zipper, detachable shoulder straps, and daisy chains. Black and Lavender.

And Tidura Core is making its debut on a brand new bag:

  • Daypack 23L — Urban daypack with roll closure, laptop compartment, and ventilated TPU back panel. Black and Dark Sand.

The Daypack 23L is a waterproof backpack built for commuting, work, and everyday life. Rated IP64 for waterproof protection, it uses a dependable roll-top closure with buckles. Outside are two mesh pockets that fit 1L water bottles, and inside is a small hidden stash pocket and a well padded removable laptop compartment for devices up to 16″.

Like all Ortlieb products, their Tidura bags offer a 5-year warranty. And replacement parts will be available for at least 10 years after that product leaves the Ortlieb collection. If there are repairs you can’t do yourself, you can send your bag to Ortlieb or one of their service partners to professionally repair it. It’s no surprise that a sustainability-focused brand like Ortlieb would take such a hands-on approach to keeping their wares in service for longer. Now, that hands-on approach starts before the products are even made.
